author: Dany_Q
quote: A scam disguised as a sequel. This is not GTA.Rating: 0 /5 stars After more than a decade of waiting and paying a small fortune for a pre-order, what we got with GTA 6 is a total slap in the face to fans of the series. Not only does it fail on a technical level, but it also completely destroyed the essence that made this franchise **** start with, the performance is unacceptable for a current-gen game. It is locked at a miserable 30 FPS that plummets the moment you enter dense areas or heavy action, making the experience clunky and nauseating. On top of that, the gameplay feels heavy and unresponsive, especially when riding motorcycles, whose physics are a total disaster; they feel stiff, weightless, and have terrible handling dynamics that drive you crazy on every **** the worst part isn't the technical side—it's the massive step backward in content and freedom compared to previous entries: Zero freedom for chaos: The game constantly punishes and restricts you if you try to cause mayhem in the open world, taking all the fun out of free roam. Cutbacks on basic content: It is unbelievable that at this point you can't buy houses or properties like in the classics, and that the arsenal is so poor, with very few weapons available.Finally, the final blow is the game's script and tone. It is completely ruined by a forced progressive agenda that watered down the dark humor, satire, and irreverence that always defined the franchise. They traded the rebellious spirit we all bought GTA for in favor of a preachy, boring **** is an absolute rip-off to sell a product in advance under a legendary name when the final result has nothing to do with the previous games. It feels like a generic, restricted, soulless game. This is not GTA
